It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:

4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: server.js, src/**
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

File: src/config/auth.js

const AUTH_COOKIE_NAME = 'auth_token';
const AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60;

const getJwtSecret = () => {
    const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
    if (!secret || secret.length < 32) {
        throw new Error('JWT_SECRET skal være konfigureret med mindst 32 tegn');
    }

    return secret;
};

const assertJwtSecretConfigured = () => {
    getJwtSecret();
};

const getAuthCookieOptions = () => ({
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS * 1000
});

module.exports = {
    AUTH_COOKIE_NAME,
    AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS,
    assertJwtSecretConfigured,
    getAuthCookieOptions,
    getJwtSecret
};

================
File: src/Middelware/authenticate.js
================
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
const { AUTH_COOKIE_NAME } = require('../config/auth');
const { verifyAccessToken } = require('../utils/authToken');

module.exports = (req, res, next) => {
    const token = req.cookies && req.cookies[AUTH_COOKIE_NAME];
    if (!token) {
        return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Login påkrævet' });
    }

    try {
        const payload = verifyAccessToken(token);
        if (typeof payload.sub !== 'string' || payload.sub.length === 0) {
            return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Ugyldig eller udløbet login-session' });
        }

        req.auth = { userId: payload.sub };
        return next();
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof jwt.JsonWebTokenError) {
            return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Ugyldig eller udløbet login-session' });
        }
        return next(error);
    }
};

================
File: src/Middelware/notFoundHandler.js
================
const path = require("node:path")

function notFoundHandler(req, res, next) {
    if (req.path === "/api" || req.path.startsWith("/api/")){
        return res.status(404).json({ error: "API ruten blev ikke fundet"})
    }

    res.status(404).type("html").sendFile(path.join(__dirname, "../Views/page-not-found.html"))

}

module.exports = notFoundHandler;

================
File: src/Services/gameService.js
================
const gameRepository = require('../Repositories/gameRepository');

const getAllGames = async () => {
    return await gameRepository.findAll();
};

const getGamesGroupedByGenre = async () => {
    const games = await gameRepository.findAll();

    return games.reduce((grouped, game) => {
        const genre = game.genre || 'Andet';
        if(!grouped[genre]) {
            grouped[genre] = [];
        }
        grouped[genre].push(game);
        return grouped;
    }, {});
};

const getGameById = async (id) => {
    const game = await gameRepository.findById(id);
    if(!game) {
        throw new Error('Spillet blev ikke fundet');
    }
    return game; 
};

module.exports = {
    getAllGames, 
    getGamesGroupedByGenre, 
    getGameById
};

================
File: src/utils/authToken.js
================
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
const {
    AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS,
    getJwtSecret
} = require('../config/auth');

exports.createAccessToken = (userId) => jwt.sign(
    {},
    getJwtSecret(),
    {
        algorithm: 'HS256',
        subject: String(userId),
        expiresIn: AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
    }
);

exports.verifyAccessToken = (token) => jwt.verify(
    token,
    getJwtSecret(),
    { algorithms: ['HS256'] }
);

================
File: src/utils/passwordHasher.js
================
const bcrypt = require('bcrypt')

const SALT_ROUNDS = 12; // Antal runder for saltning af password

exports.hashPassword = async (plainPassword) => {
    return await bcrypt.hash(plainPassword, SALT_ROUNDS)
}

exports.comparePassword = async (plainPassword, hashedPassword) => {
    return await bcrypt.compare(plainPassword, hashedPassword)
}

File: src/Validators/accountValidator.js

const joi = require('joi');

const registerSchema = joi.object({
    username: joi.string().trim().min(3).max(30).required(),
    email: joi.string().trim().email().required(),
    password: joi.string().min(8).max(128).required()
});

const loginSchema = joi.object({
    email: joi.string().trim().email().required(),
    password: joi.string().required()
});

exports.validateRegister = (req, res, next) => {
    const { error, value } = registerSchema.validate(req.body);
    if (error) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: error.details[0].message });
    }
    req.body = value;
    next();
};

exports.validateLogin = (req, res, next) => {
    const { error, value } = loginSchema.validate(req.body);
    if (error) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: error.details[0].message });
    }
    req.body = value;
    next();
};

    if (error) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: error.details[0].message });

const mongoose = require('mongoose');

const gameSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    id: { type: Number, required: true, unique: true },
    title: { type: String, required: true },
    thumbnail: { type: String, required: true },
    short_description: String,
    genre: { type: String, required: true },
    platform: String,
    publisher: String,
    developer: String,
    release_date: String,
    freetogame_profile_url: String,
    price: { type: Number, default: 150 }
});

module.exports = mongoose.model('Game', gameSchema);

File: src/Services/profileService.js
================
const userRepository = require("../Repositories/userRepository");
const AppError = require("../utils/AppError");

const toProfile = (user) => ({
    id: user._id,
    username: user.username,
    imageUrl: user.imageUrl,
    description: user.description ?? ''
});

exports.getProfile = async (userId) => {
    const user = await userRepository.getUserById(userId);
    if (!user) {
        throw new AppError('Profilen blev ikke fundet', 404);
    }

    return toProfile(user);
};

exports.UpdateUser = async (description, userId) => {
    const updatedUser = await userRepository.updateUser({ description }, userId);
    if (!updatedUser) {
        throw new AppError('Karakteren blev ikke opdateret');
    }
    return toProfile(updatedUser);
}

================
File: src/Controllers/accountController.js
================
const accountService = require('../Services/accountService');
const authToken = require('../utils/authToken');
const {
    AUTH_COOKIE_NAME,
    getAuthCookieOptions
} = require('../config/auth');

exports.handleRegister = async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
        const user = await accountService.register(req.body);
        res.status(201).json({
            message: 'Bruger oprettet',
            user // Returner den oprettede bruger uden password
        });
    } catch (error) {
        next(error);
    }
};

exports.handleLogin = async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
        const user = await accountService.login(req.body);
        const token = authToken.createAccessToken(user.id);
        res.cookie(AUTH_COOKIE_NAME, token, getAuthCookieOptions());
        res.status(200).json({
            message: 'Login gennemført',
            user
        });
    } catch (error) {
        next(error);
    }
};

exports.handleLogout = (_req, res) => {
    const { maxAge, ...clearCookieOptions } = getAuthCookieOptions();
    res.clearCookie(AUTH_COOKIE_NAME, clearCookieOptions);
    res.status(200).json({ message: 'Logget ud' });
};

exports.handleCurrentUser = async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
        const user = await accountService.getAuthenticatedUser(req.auth.userId);
        res.status(200).json({ user });
    } catch (error) {
        next(error);
    }
};

================
File: src/Middelware/errorHandler.js
================
const AppError = require("../utils/AppError")

function errorHandler(err, _req, res, _next){
    if (err instanceof AppError){
        return res.status(err.status).json({error: err.message})
    }
    // Handle specific Mongoose errors
    // Duplicate key error (e.g., unique constraint violation)
    if (err.code === 11000) {
        return res.status(409).json({ error: 'Email er allerede i brug' });
    }
    if (err.name === 'ValidationError' || err.name === 'CastError') {
        return res.status(400).json({error: 'Ugyldige data'});
    }
    if (err.type === 'entity.parse.failed'){
        return res.status(400).json({error: 'Ugyldigt JSON'});
    }
    console.error('Uventet serverfejl:', err);
    res.status(500).json({error: 'Intern serverfejl'});
}
module.exports = errorHandler

File: src/Middelware/validateUser.js
================
const mongoose = require('mongoose');
const AppError = require('../utils/AppError')


function validateUserData(req, res, next) {
    const name = req.body?.username?.trim();
    const email = req.body?.email?.trim();
    const password = req.body?.password.trim();

    if (typeof name !== 'string') { // sikrer at name er en string - ingen numbers
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Brugernavn skal være en string'
        });
    }

    if (!name) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Brugernavn er påkrævet'
        });
    }

    if (name.length < 3) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Brugernavn skal være mindst 3 tegn'
        });
    }

    if (typeof email !== 'string') { // sikrer at email er en string - ingen numbers
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Email skal være en string'
        });
    }

    if (!email) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Email er påkrævet'
        });
    }

    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Email har ugyldigt format'
        });
    }

    if (!password || password === '') {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: 'Password må ikke være tomt'
        })
    }

    req.body.username = name;
    req.body.email = email;
    req.body.password = password
    next(); // fortsæt til næste middleware eller controller
}

function validateId(req, res, next) {
    if (!mongoose.isObjectIdOrHexString(req.params.id)) {
        return next(new AppError('Ugyldigt ID', 400))
    }
    next()
}

module.exports = { validateUserData, validateId};

File: src/Models/userModel.js
================
const mongoose = require("mongoose");

const userSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    username: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Name is required']
    },
    email: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Email is required'],
        unique: true,
        lowercase: true
    },
    password: {
        type: String,
        required: [true, 'Password is required'],
        select: false // This will prevent the password from being returned in queries by default
    },
    description: {
        type: String,
        default: '',
        maxLength: [500, 'Description cannot exceed 500 characters']
    },
    imageUrl: {
        type: String,
        default: ''
    }
});


module.exports = mongoose.model('User', userSchema);

/** En domæne-/appikationsfejl med status til HTTP-grænsen.
 * Bruges i service; selve modellen og repository kender ikke HTTP.
 */
class AppError extends Error {
    constructor(message, status = 500) { super(message); this.name = 'AppError'; this.status = status; }
}
module.exports = AppError;

// Bliver ikke brugt, skal opdates så den
// tager højde for update profil logik, IKKE create
const userValidationSchema = joi.object({
    username: joi.string().required(),
    email: joi.string().email().required(),
    password: joi.string().required(),
})

exports.validateUser = (req, res, next) => {
    const {error} = userValidationSchema.validate(req.body);

    if (error) {
        return res.status(400).json({error: error.details[0].message});
    }
    next();
}

================
File: src/Services/accountService.js
================
// register og login
const userRepository = require('../Repositories/userRepository');
const passwordHasher = require('../utils/passwordHasher');
const AppError = require('../utils/AppError');

const toSafeUser = (user) => ({
    id: user._id,
    username: user.username,
    email: user.email,
    imageUrl: user.imageUrl,
    description: user.description ?? ''
});

exports.register = async ({ username, email, password }) => {
    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();

    const existingUser = await userRepository.getUserByEmail(normalizedEmail);
    if (existingUser) {
        throw new AppError('Der findes allerede en bruger med denne email', 409);
    }

    const hashedPassword = await passwordHasher.hashPassword(password);

    const newUser = await userRepository.createUser({
        username: username.trim(),
        email: normalizedEmail,
        password: hashedPassword
    });

    if (!newUser) {
        throw new AppError('Brugeren kunne ikke oprettes', 500);
    }

    return toSafeUser(newUser);
};

exports.login = async ({ email, password }) => {
    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();

    const user = await userRepository.getUserByEmailWithPassword(normalizedEmail);

    // Returnér samme fejl ved ukendt email og forkert password (forhindrer user enumeration)
    if (!user) {
        throw new AppError('Ugyldig email eller adgangskode', 401);
    }

    const isPasswordValid = await passwordHasher.comparePassword(password, user.password);
    if (!isPasswordValid) {
        throw new AppError('Ugyldig email eller adgangskode', 401);
    }

    return toSafeUser(user);
};

exports.getAuthenticatedUser = async (userId) => {
    const user = await userRepository.getUserById(userId);
    if (!user) {
        throw new AppError('Brugeren findes ikke længere', 401);
    }

    return toSafeUser(user);
};

        return res.status(200).json({user})

        res.status(404).json({error: error.message})

File: src/Repositories/userRepository.js
================
const User = require('../Models/userModel');

exports.createUser = async (user) => {
    return await User.create(user);
}

exports.getAllUsers = async () => {
    return await User.find()
}

exports.getUserById = async (id) => {
    return await User.findById(id)
}

exports.updateUser = async (userData, id) => {
    return await User.findByIdAndUpdate(id, {$set: userData, returnDocument: 'after', runValidators: true})
}

exports.deleteUser = async (id) => {
    await User.findByIdAndDelete(id)
}

exports.getUserByEmail = async (email) => {
    return await User.findOne({ email: email.toLowerCase()}); 
}

exports.getUserByEmailWithPassword = async (email) => {
    return await User.findOne({ email: email.toLowerCase()}).select('+password') // This will include the password field in the result
}

//Her er Database forbindelsen

const mongoose = require('mongoose');

const connectDB = async () => {
    const connectionString =
        process.env.MONGO_URI || process.env.MONGODB_URI;
    if (!connectionString) throw new Error('MONGO_URI mangler i .env');
    await mongoose.connect(connectionString);
    console.log('MongoDB tilsluttet');
};

module.exports = connectDB;

exports.DeleteUser = async (userId) => {
    const user = await userRepository.deleteUser(userId);
    
    if (!user) {
        throw new AppError('Karakteren blev ikke fundet');
    }

    return null;
}

exports.GetUserById = async (userId) => {
    const user = await userRepository.getUserById(userId);
    if (!user) {
        throw new AppError('Karakteren blev ikke fundet');
    }
    return user;
}

exports.GetAllUsers = async () => {
    return await userRepository.getAllUsers();
}

================
File: server.js
================
require('dotenv').config();
const app = require('./src/app');
const connectDB = require('./src/config/database');
const { assertJwtSecretConfigured } = require('./src/config/auth');
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;


const start = async () => {
    assertJwtSecretConfigured();
    await connectDB();
    app.listen(PORT, () => {
        console.log(`Serveren kører på http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    });
};


// void start() så der ikke er nogen floating promise warning i console,
// hvis der er en fejl i start() og den ikke fanges
void start().catch((error) => {
    console.error('Serveren kunne ikke starte:', error.message);
    process.exitCode = 1; // Valgfrit - sikre serveren ikke starter, hvis der ikke er forbindelse til databasen
});

================
File: src/app.js
================
const express = require("express");
const morgan = require("morgan");
const cookieParser = require('cookie-parser');
const userRouter = require('./Routes/userRoutes');
const gameRouter = require('./Routes/gameRoutes');
const accountRoutes = require("./Routes/accountRoutes");
const profileRoutes = require("./Routes/profileRoutes");

const notFoundHandler = require("./Middelware/notFoundHandler")
const errorHandler = require("./Middelware/errorHandler")

const app = express();

app.use(morgan("dev"));
app.use(express.json());
app.use(cookieParser());
app.use('/api/users', userRouter);
app.use('/api/games', gameRouter);
app.use('/api/account', accountRoutes);
app.use('/api/profile', profileRoutes);


app.use(express.static("public/static"))
app.use(express.static("public"));

app.use(notFoundHandler)
app.use(errorHandler);

module.exports = app;
